name: Default stage prompts
description:
We want to make it really easy for people to standup a software factory. Using the stage prompts Rowbly uses for internal development (located within .rowbly), create a series of default stage prompts for the default columns.

When setting up rowbly as a software factory. We should have the following stages

- Backlog
- TODO
- In Progress
- In Review
- Done

For non-factory setups, use the following columns


- Backlog
- TODO
- In Progress
- Done


Add default stage prompts when using software factory. Use defaults from internal development, make sure to modify them to remove anything custom to the project. Stages assume that a user has/will install the accompanying skills
